name: Conservative Broadcast Media & Journalism Inc.
summary: Conservative Broadcast Media & Journalism Inc. operates primarily as a digital marketing firm. The company maintains a significant online footprint, boasting roughly 2 million followers across various social media platforms and managing an active database of approximately 12 million email subscribers who have opted in. Furthermore, it oversees a network of 47 news and political websites that are monetized. Beyond its core digital operations, CBMJ also preserves and presents historical documents through its website, constitution.com. The company extends its reach into physical retail with a coffee shop situated in Hiram, Georgia, alongside several e-commerce ventures such as thrashercoffee.com, valloranicigars.com, and store.flagandcross.com. Its content is disseminated across television, radio, and social media channels. The organization, headquartered in Powder Springs, Georgia, previously traded under the name Canna Consumer Goods Inc. before officially rebranding to Conservative Broadcast Media and Journalism, Inc. in November 2020.
